server.invalidDocumentId: That is not a valid file id.
server.notFound: This file could not be found. It may have been deleted, or it is in a folder you cannot open.
server.editDenied: You can view this file but not edit it.
server.notEditable: This kind of file can't be edited in LaunchStack. Markdown, plain text and Word files can.
server.invalid: The editor sent something LaunchStack could not save. Reload the file and try again.
server.tooLarge: This file is too large to edit here (the limit is {mb} MB).
server.changedSinceOpened: This file changed since you opened it. Reload to get the latest version, then make your edits again.
server.changedInGoogleDocs: This file was changed in Google Docs since you opened it. Reload to get the latest version, then make your edits again.
server.googleNotConnected: LaunchStack's Google connection for this workspace is missing or was revoked, so this linked file can't be opened or saved. An admin can reconnect Google in Settings.
server.driveUnavailable: Google Drive didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
server.driveDisabled: Google Drive is turned off on this server, so this linked file can't be saved.
server.driveFileGone: The linked Google Docs file was deleted or moved to the trash. Reload to edit LaunchStack's copy instead.
server.readFailed: LaunchStack couldn't read this file from storage (HTTP {status}).
server.saveFailed: The file couldn't be saved. Try again.
server.docxNotice: Saving keeps headings, lists, bold and italic, links, tables and images. Page layout, headers and footers, tracked changes and comments are dropped. The previous version stays in History.
server.driveNotice: Saving replaces the Google Doc's content. Comments and suggestions left in Google Docs are lost. The previous version stays in History.
server.invalidTitleOrFolder: That title or folder can't be used.
server.folderDenied: You do not have edit access to this folder.
server.createFailed: The file couldn't be created. Try again.
